title: 9tz.10: E2E test: POST article, SEARCH finds it
description:
What: End-to-end integration test: POST an article, verify NNTP SEARCH finds it by body content, and JMAP Email/query text filter finds it.

Algorithm:
1. In crates/reader/tests/ add e2e_search.rs (or add to existing integration test):
   - Start in-memory stores via ServerStores::new_mem()
   - POST an article with known body text 'frobnicator hypothesis'
   - Call NNTP SEARCH BODY 'frobnicator' → verify response contains the article number
   - Call NNTP SEARCH BODY 'nonexistent_xyz_term_999' → verify empty result
   - Call JMAP Email/query with filter: {"text": "frobnicator"} → verify returned email ID matches

2. Test oracle: 'frobnicator hypothesis' is hand-chosen to be unique; its presence in results is independent of the code under test (the oracle is the known article content, not the indexer output fed back in).

3. Also test: SEARCH while no group selected → 412 response.

4. Also test: search when index_dir is None → 503 response.

Defensive rules: Do not use search results as oracles for further searches. Use hand-crafted expected article numbers.
